⛔ SNG-439. THE NEXUS MAP AND THE MOON. Erik, 2026-08-15: 'The cogitants should have skills that use PSYCHIC energy, which they unlock through the powers of the mind. The meaning people, numinous, will use something similar — the metaphysical powers. We'll need a map of NEXUSES that will be a variable power source for them all — perhaps also the MOON CYCLE could give a bonus (light and dark) depending on the phase.'
⚠️ HALF OF THIS ALREADY EXISTS AND NOTHING READS IT. `power_sources.json` says `metaphysical` 'WANTS THIN GROUND: a dense lattice is apparatus standing between the practitioner and the thing itself', with a density band {0.15, 0.22}. And `substrateDensity` varies 0.12–0.98 across 39 regions. ⛔ THE VARIABLE POWER SOURCE IS ALREADY ON THE MAP. A nexus is where it PEAKS.
_theModel:
⛔ A NEXUS IS NOT A NEW FIELD — IT IS AN EXTREMUM OF ONE THAT EXISTS. Two kinds, because the sources want opposite ground:
   THIN NEXUS — substrate density at a local minimum. Metaphysical and psychic draw here. The lattice is not in the way.
   DEEP NEXUS — density at a local maximum. Precursor and lattice crafts draw here.
⚠️ THAT MEANS THE SAME MAP POWERS BOTH, IN OPPOSITE DIRECTIONS, and a party of mixed traditions is always somewhere that suits someone. ⛔ THAT IS THE INTERESTING VERSION — a Cogitant and a Figurist want different ground, and the route becomes an argument.

_mechanic: ⛑ RULED, Erik 2026-09-16. A craft's effective magnitude shifts by how well the local density matches its source's band: **ON-BAND +2 · ONE STEP OFF −1 · TWO STEPS OFF −4 · AT A MATCHING NEXUS +6.** ⚠️ WAS PROPOSED AS +2/+0/−2/+4 AND ERIK WIDENED IT: at −2/+2 the nexus bonus was only twice the best ordinary ground, so a Blazeborn at the Lensward was A BIT BETTER than a Blazeborn in a sunny field. ⛔ A NEXUS IS THE WALL AT ITS THICKEST AND, SINCE SNG-602, THE PLACE WHERE THE MOST CHANNELLED SOUL IS HELD. Arriving at one should feel like arriving somewhere. ⛑ The penalty half already runs — `substrate.js` computes `chancePenalty` and `energyMult` and `skill_battle.js:1026` shows it on the roll as 'the ground here (metaphysical, 51% of its strength)'. **What this ruling adds is the reward half and the nexus step.**

moon._note: ⛔ NEW — no moon exists in canon. Search returned zero for moon, lunar and phase. ⚠️ SO THE MOON ITSELF NEEDS ERIK'S RULING BEFORE THE MECHANIC: how many moons, and does this world's sky work like ours? The Crossing is the south pole and the world is 0.38× Earth.
moon._proposal:
A single moon, 28-day cycle, tracked against `worldDay` which already exists. It modulates the DARK_LIGHT axis only — not everything, or it becomes a global weather system nobody can plan around.
   FULL — Blazeborn and Radiant crafts +2; Umbral −2
   NEW  — Umbral and Veilwright +2; Blazeborn −2
   QUARTERS — no modifier, and that is most of the month
⚠️ THE ASYMMETRY IS THE FICTION: an Umbral plans raids by the calendar and a Blazeborn does not have to, which tells you something true about both.
moon._erikRules: whether there is a moon at all, how many, and whether it touches more than dark_light

_theSleepers_20260912._statement: ⛔ SNG-553, Erik 2026-09-12. **EACH SITE THAT CAN WAKE HAS A BEING THAT WAKES FROM IT.** Erik: 'these entities are still tuned and in control of their lattice constructs, so they can be of your party and yet able to activate and control their massive machines. It doesn't have to be every site.' ⚠️ THIS IS WHAT THE NEXUSES ARE FOR, AND IT REPLACES THE BUFF-PAD READING. A nexus is not a place that makes your numbers bigger. **It is a vault with somebody in it.**
_theSleepers_20260912._whyOnlyTheDeepOnes: ⛑ A LATTICE-TUNED BEING CAN ONLY BE WHERE THE LATTICE IS. The four DEEP nexuses run 0.88–0.98; the four THIN run 0.12–0.32 and are holes in the wall, not vaults — there is nothing there to be tuned to. ⛔ SO THERE ARE AT MOST FOUR, AND ERIK'S 'it doesn't have to be every site' IS THE SCARCITY THAT MAKES IT A DECISION. ⚠️ At least one deep vault should be EMPTY, or its occupant already awake and walking and saying nothing — because a set the player can complete is a collection, and this must not be one.
_theSleepers_20260912._theConstraintThatMakesItWork: ⛔ **THE BEING TRAVELS. THE CONSTRUCT DOES NOT.** ⚠️ You gain a companion with memory, judgment and opinions who walks anywhere — and their machine answers ONLY WHERE IT STANDS. ⛑ So waking a site is a decision about WHICH PART OF THE WORLD YOU CAN ACT DECISIVELY IN, not a portable superweapon. ⛔ AND IT FINALLY DELIVERS WHAT `_mechanic` SAYS THE WHOLE SYSTEM IS FOR: 'the point is that where you stand matters, which is the thing a map is for and the thing this game's map has not yet done.'
_theSleepers_20260912._theyAreAlsoTheOffSwitch: ⚠️ TUNED AND IN CONTROL MEANS THEY CAN STOP IT TOO. ⛔ The constructs are already running standing instructions nobody alive chose — 'prepare the watershed' is one of them. **Waking the occupant is how you get a hand on the lever in either direction**, which makes 'leave it sleeping' genuinely expensive: you also decline the ability to turn it off later.
_theSleepers_20260912._theRelationshipIsNotOwnership: ⛔ SPARK'S GRAMMAR GOVERNS: 'IT IS ITS OWN FROM THE FIRST MOMENT — IT DOES NOT OWE YOU.' A woken being can refuse, can leave, can side against you. ⚠️ YOU DO NOT ACQUIRE THEM. You persuade them, continuously — the middle way applied to a companion instead of a cosmology.
_theSleepers_20260912._andTheyDoNotAgreeWithEachOther: ⛔ THE BRAKE, AND IT IS IN THE COSMOLOGY RATHER THAN IN PLAYER RESTRAINT. They are of one people, and that people is DEFINED by an ancient disagreement. **A woken being may actively oppose waking the next one, and be right.** ⚠️ FOUR WOKEN BEINGS IS FOUR INSTALLATIONS, WHICH IS THE ALL-AWAKENED ENDGAME REACHED ONE REASONABLE STEP AT A TIME. Player restraint cannot be the only brake. ⛑ THIS TURNS THE ENDGAME FROM A COLLECTION INTO AN ARGUMENT THE PLAYER IS INSIDE OF, with parties who have standing and cannot all be satisfied — **the Precursor argument held in one company and refereed by a mortal, which is the vacancy the seeded were grown into** (`power_cosmology.theMiddleWay._whoHasHeldIt`).
_theSleepers_20260912._theAppetite: ⛔ ERIK 2026-09-12, CONFIRMED: 'the awakened beings with that much raw soul channeling power are likely EXTREMELY APPETIZING to the Veil beings.' ⚠️ SO WAKING ONE DOES NOT DETER THE BURNERS — IT ADVERTISES. A ripened Precursor being is the largest concentration of KEPT soul in existence (`power_cosmology.theTwoMethods`), and to something that runs on combustion that is not an enemy, it is **the richest fuel deposit ever brought to the surface.** ⛔ BURIED THEY ARE DISTRIBUTED, INERT AND HARD TO REACH. AWAKE THEY ARE WHOLE, CONCENTRATED, WALKING AROUND IN THE OPEN, AND BONDED TO A MORTAL WHO CAN BE LEVERAGED. ⚠️ AND IT REFRAMES ANY EASY VICTORY: Sovereigns and Veil-folk dying off after a waking is not the war being won, it is THE NEAR ONES BEING CLEARED OUT OF THE WAY. They were opportunists at a thin spot — not the strongest, the nearest. **What comes after is whatever never needed a thin spot.**
_theSleepers_20260912._theCostOfUsingIt: ⬜ PROPOSED, NOT RULED. Commanding war infrastructure should cost the wielder's VECTOR the way `Foreclose` does — 'the most perilous ability in the game to the wielder's own vector'. ⚠️ Using the machine is a USE; the third front is whether what the seeded make is ever offered as an ANSWER rather than a use. ⛑ **SO THE INTERESTING PLAY IS NEVER FIRING IT. It is what you and the being decide to do with an installation that COULD fire, and choosing not to.**
_theSleepers_20260912._theCarriedForm: ⛑ ERIK 2026-09-12, and it applies to all of them: the small form PERSISTS. Marrow is Maren Ossitide and is still the corvid. ⛔ WAKING IS ADDITIVE, NOT TRANSFORMATIVE — nobody loses a companion by finishing their arc. ⚠️ And it gives each sleeper two registers to be written in: how they are with you, and how they are with the world.

_theOrgans_20260916: ⛔ ERIK 2026-09-16, RULING `onActivation`: 'for each body part they would be wells or sinks for certain attributes. So those who hold a nexus hold a point of power that can be tuned to bolster their side and/or weaken the other's side.' ⛑ EIGHT NEXUSES, EIGHT SUB-ATTRIBUTES, AND THE MAPPING FALLS OUT OF WHAT EACH SITE ALREADY SAID IT WAS. Nobody designed that correspondence — `tierFloor` has four attributes of two each, and the world has four deep sites and four thin ones. ⚠️ THE DEEP ONES HOLD THE MADE FACULTIES (craft, reason, strength, insight) AND THE THIN ONES HOLD THE LIVING ONES (rapport, wits, agility, presence), which is the wall's own division: what was built, and what was left unbuilt on purpose. ⛔ A HELD NEXUS IS TUNED, NOT SWITCHED. It is a WELL for one side and a SINK against the other, and the holder chooses how far toward either — all the way to a well, all the way to a sink, or balanced and quiet. ⚠️ AND IT IS SOUL, WHICH MEANS IT IS NOT FREE: a well channels and keeps, a sink takes from people who are using the faculty it drains. **Tuning a nexus hard against an enemy is the Sovereigns' method performed with the Precursors' machine**, and the middle way's whole objection is that it works.
_vectorsAssigned_20260916: ⛔ ERIK 2026-09-16: 'of the 8, at least 1 should have an entity predisposed to the Void's way of thinking, one that supports the Veil, and one that wants the balance.' ⛑ Three assigned, and each was already leaning that way in its own authored text — the Arcology is order made structural, the Unwalled Quiet is where neither side ever built, and the Rootkin decline to use Heartroot. ⬜ THE OTHER FIVE ARE DELIBERATELY UNASSIGNED: a site with no declared vector is a site somebody can turn, which is what makes turning nexuses a campaign rather than a checklist.
